decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times Monday to Friday 0900-1900 and Saturdays 0900-1700.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the estate agents shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - 
Within 3 months of the date of this permission, a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled employees to gain access to the toilets adapted for use for people with disabilities shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority and shall be implemented within 3 months of the approval and shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Proposed change of use from office (Use Class B1) to estate agent (use Class A2)
